definitions.gloss: to surface; to rise to the surface
definitions.explanation: To come up from underwater or below the surface.

definitions.gloss: to emerge; to come to light; to become clear
definitions.explanation: For something hidden or unclear to become apparent or visible.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ (to float) + ⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧ (to rise)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる - intransitive in every sense; the thing that surfaces or emerges takes ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる - the surface or background it rises to: ⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- 〜⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる - what it comes out of: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧, ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧

ASPECT (ている):
This is a change-of-state verb, so {浮|う}かび{上|あ}がって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the resulting state - the thing is now up, or now visible - rather than an action in progress. The form {浮|う}かび{上|あ}がって⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧, very common in sense 2, adds the sense of the fact coming into view step by step.

USAGE:
Sense 1 is physical: ⟦{潜水艦|せんすいかん}→潜水艦：15701_sensuikan⟧, ⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧, a sunken ship, a ⟦ダイバー→ダイバー：28769_daibaa⟧.

Sense 2 is standard vocabulary in news and investigation writing:
- ⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (a suspect emerges)
- ⟦{疑惑|ぎわく}→疑惑：13602_giwaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (suspicions arise)
- ⟦{真相|しんそう}→真相：17447_shinsou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (the truth comes to light)
- ⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (issues emerge)

A third use, not split out as a separate sense here, is visual: a shape standing out against a dark or plain background, as in ⟦ライト→ライト：13631_raito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{照|て}らされて→照らす：04669_terasu⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる (lit up, the building stands out of the darkness).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{浮|う}き{彫|ぼ}り→浮き彫り：13305_ukibori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to be thrown into relief; a near-synonym of sense 2, and slightly more formal

SIMILAR WORDS:
The base verb ⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ on its own can mean "to come to mind", but {浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる does not: an idea is ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧, never ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がる.
